issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: red_wall_banner, cauldron.
438 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Capped at 1: the new A-frame and throwing arm are inside, out of sight; outside only two banners and lean-to shutters are new.
notes.purpose: Catapult is almost invisible: hidden under the low roof in every iso, and from the front only a pale block mass shows behind the dark beam at (3..7,4,1).
notes.levels: The author's worry is right: L2 is indistinguishable from L1 in iso, back and right views; only two red banners at the front show.
notes.scale: The A-frame (fences at x4/x6 z6) and arm (stairs at (5,4,7),(5,5,8), cauldron at (5,6,9)) are in proportion, but nobody can see them.

visual.summary: L1 plus the catapult's A-frame, axle, throwing arm and cauldron bucket, front banners and lean-to shutters; the new feature is hidden inside the shed.
problems: The L2 feature (catapult A-frame and arm) cannot be seen from outside: move or show it (front opening, lowered front beam at y4 z1, an open side bay without the lean-to in front of it) so L2 tells apart from L1 at a glance.
Floating blocks: oak slabs at (6,2,2) and (7,2,2) have nothing under them (y1 is air there); add the bench legs or remove them.
Back gable has a 1-block hole at (5,5,11) (row 'VTT.TTW'); fill it or make it a clear vent (trapdoor/fence).
Front gable is completely open (y5..6 at z1); for a shed that is acceptable, but give it barge boards or a partial infill so it looks finished.
Lean-to roof (spruce slabs at y3, x9..12 z2..10) is dead flat and reads as a deck; slope it with stairs down to x12.
Reachability: fine; unreached places are roof slopes, the flat lean-to roof and catapult/bench tops, no room or floor is cut off.

The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.levels: Throwing arm with cauldron cup and red banners on the front gable are visible from the front and iso.
notes.detail: New feature is the arm plus banners; otherwise the same as L1.

visual.summary: L1 plus the catapult's throwing arm and cauldron cup over the stop bar, and red banners on the front gable posts.
problems: The arm is now visible from the front; the L2 change is still small, so make the arm longer/raised so it stands out above the yard.
Same one-tone roof and brown timber as L1.
Reachability: fine; only roof slopes, prop and furniture tops are unreached, no room or floor is cut off.
